Your account data

POIGAI stores the account details you enter, your consent time, email verification status, password hash and session records to operate and secure your account. Passwords are never stored as readable text. Security request limits use hashed network and email identifiers.

Cloudflare hosts account data and Resend delivers verification and recovery emails. Account details are not displayed publicly. Keep confidential project documents out of registration fields. To request access, correction or deletion, email contact@poigai.com. Marketing consent is not included in account registration.
